issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. Each candidate packing is built by the script (hex-grid, hex-init or physics start), then improved by an SLSQP polish and an LP solve for the radii.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The change is a two-stage search: about 70 s of short polishes (maxiter=40), then full polishes (maxiter=300) on the 10 best candidates, capped at 60 s. Together that is about 130 s, well inside the 4-minute margin. The best packing from the first stage stays as a fallback. The tail of the second-stage loop is not in the diff, so I assume it updates best the same way the old loop did.
The run count depends on the clock (time-based loops), so results can vary slightly between runs even with the fixed seed. This is a minor reproducibility point, not grounds for a veto.
